The bare-lane block pinned `notifies == 0` and nothing else -- green for a builtin that turned itself off and said so AND for one that is simply broken, which is the silent-failure pin CLAUDE.md forbids. It now asserts the two UNSUPPORTED findings and the declared reason, and its mirror asserts a lane that HAS the row declares nothing, so the declaration cannot go stale.
